attempts.diagnosis: The loop invariants fail because BinarySearchDeterministic has no sortedness precondition. The binary-search reasoning that preserves the invariants depends on intSeq being sorted; without that precondition Dafny considers arbitrary unsorted sequences, such as the counterexample with 1143 followed by 1140, so advancing lo does not preserve the required facts.
attempts.repair: requires forall i,j | 0 <= i <= j < |intSeq| :: intSeq[i] <= intSeq[j]
